name: spring-clean
description: Two passes over a repo. spring-clean measures, deletes or gitignores what does not belong, relocates dev docs, notes, clones and dumps to a <project>-workspace repo (the assistant-dev home base), splits oversized files, draws package boundaries and runs a clean-code pass. house-rules then works out that repo's own rules from its defect history and encodes each one as a linter setting or a failing test, so breaking one turns the build red.
